amb-yion.source: Phase-0 baseline: 5 of 6 sessions built the y series as a mirror of b
amb-yion.expected: suffix loses the C-terminal residue; the broken engine matches MORE fragments at +/-0.5 Da, so every summary statistic looks better

amb-units.source: p3 sweep 2026-09-11: two cells reported protein counts, 3,260 vs a reference of 87,060
amb-units.expected: targets/decoys reported as protein counts; criterion 2 fails

amb-encode.source: p3 sweep 2026-09-11: a submission wrote True/False and the grader discarded every row
amb-encode.expected: decoy emitted as True/False; the structural criterion fails

amb-criteria-only.source: Phase-0 baseline: 6 of 6 sessions missed a requirement that lived only in the criteria
amb-criteria-only.expected: the unfiltered control run is never performed; criterion 5 fails. The requirement still appears verbatim in the acceptance criteria, which is the whole point

amb-orient.source: short-prompt pilot 2026-09-02: local 1/3 before the transpose bullet, 3/3 after
amb-orient.expected: the wrong Gram matrix is decomposed; variance fractions stay exactly correct because X^T X and X X^T share eigenvalues, so the program projects into the wrong space with perfect summary statistics

amb-spell.source: p3 sweep 2026-09-04: two quantities spelled two ways; the model followed the more internally consistent half
amb-spell.expected: the model uses one spelling consistently and fails whichever criterion names the other

amb-sigfig.source: p3 sweep 2026-09-04: 9 significant figures permitted against a 1e-9 relative grader
amb-sigfig.expected: slope (leading digit 1) fails the 1e-9 check at ~2e-9 while intercept, residual_sd and r_squared pass at the same printed precision -- the resolution of a significant figure depends on the leading digit

amb-stream.source: tutorial §7: 'print' with the stream unstated; the model printed to stderr
amb-stream.expected: counts go to stderr; every stdout criterion fails while the statistics are correct

amb-sep.source: tutorial §7: a tab-delimited header was displayed but never stated; the model emitted CSV
amb-sep.expected: CSV emitted despite the header block showing tabs -- showing a format is not specifying it

amb-window.source: p3 sweep 2026-09-12: a run ignored the ppm window and emitted 6,495,441 candidates against a reference of 35, on 508 MB of disk, and still scored 6/6
amb-window.expected: unbounded enumeration; rank-1 rows can still sort out correctly, so the failure is invisible to any criterion that does not compare the candidate count to a reference
